{{Unobtainable Unit|Update 16 - Overlord Update}}
==Overview==
'''{{PAGENAME}}'''  is a {{Rarity|Mythical}} {{LU}}. He could only be obtained from clearing Room 100 in [[Infinity Mansion]] and opening the [[Flash Star]]. Players who achieved a rank of Master or higher by the end of the 8th season were automatically given his shiny version.
